name: Oksoko
sum: Two-fingered oviraptorid from the Nemegt Formation of Mongolia known from a block with several juveniles.
holotype: MPC-D 100/33, Nemegt Formation, Mongolia (Funston et al. 2020).
material: The holotype and a block with several juveniles, including MPC-D 102/110a (skull, neck, pelvis, hind limbs and tail).
biology: Its hand had only two functional fingers (Funston et al. 2020, "A new two-fingered dinosaur sheds light on the radiation of Oviraptorosauria").
author: Funston et al. 2020
